messages:
Ana P: Heads up: mkdocs build on staging failed after the last docs PR. Error points at an MDX file with an HTML comment inside a fenced codeblock.
Jared R: can you paste the error?
Ana P: error snippet from CI:
```
ValueError: Unexpected HTML comment in mdx code block at docs/guides/auth.mdx:42
```
I traced it to a codeblock that contains `<!-- TODO: remove this snippet -->` inside triple-backticks.
docs-bot: lint: mdx-codeblock-escape -> detected raw HTML comments inside code blocks. Suggest escaping or using HTML entities.
Nina: interesting — in plain markdown it's fine, but MDX parser treats `<!--` specially even inside fenced blocks depending on parser config. Might be varying between local env and CI docker image.
Jared R: quick fix: wrap the inner comment in an HTML-escaped form like `<!-- TODO -->` or prefix the code fence with ```text so parser doesn't try to parse HTML.
Ana P: I applied an immediate patch that escapes the comment and submitted PR 4312. But we should avoid ad-hoc fixes. We need a pre-commit hook or CI check that flags raw `<!--` inside code fences.
docs-bot: suggestion: add a remark-lint rule `no-html-comment-in-code` to docs-lint config.
Nina: I'll prototype a tiny remark plugin that walks fenced code nodes and searches for `<!--` sequences. It can report and optionally auto-escape. Will add a CLI flag for `--auto-fix`.
Jared R: also noticed some SDK snippets have platform-specific backticks that break syntax highlighting and cause the link checker to miscalculate anchor offsets. Example: a snippet with inline HTML id on a heading inside a codeblock. That moved anchor positions and triggered broken cross-page fragment tests.
Ana P: ugh. Can we standardize snippet formatting? Maybe we add a pre-commit formatter for code fences: enforce language tag, ensure no inline headings or HTML ids inside code fences, and normalize trailing newline.
Nina: sounds good. I'll add tests covering: 1) codeblocks with `<!--` flagged, 2) codeblocks with `# Heading {#id}` flagged, 3) malformed fenced blocks missing language tag.
Jared R: also let's document the recommended snippet style in docs contributors: small checklist and an example snippet template. I'll add `docs/STYLEGUIDE/snippets.md` in the PR.
Ana P: CI change request: add `docs:lint-snippets` job that runs before linkcheck. If it fails, skip linkcheck and mark the PR as needs-fix to avoid noisy Netlify previews.
ops-deploy-bot: job queued: docs:lint-snippets (pending).
Nina: I pushed PR-4313 with the remark rule + tests. PR-4312 is the immediate fix. Please review both; after merging, we can run a one-off job to scan the rest of the repo for offending snippets and open targeted cleanup PRs.
Ana P: thanks. If we get the auto-fix flag in, we can progressively fix historical files in a bulk commit to avoid many small PRs.
Jared R: agreed. Also add a short note in the contribution guide about running `yarn docs:lint` locally.
Ana P: will do. Closing loop: reviewers, please prioritize these two PRs so Netlify can green up for the upcoming release.
docs-bot: reminder: linkcheck will run after lint jobs pass.
